measurement: funded-venue spread at the probed window
method: mt5.copy_ticks_from over six recent Mondays; spread=(ask-bid)/0.01
caveat: n=6 reopens is a thin bound on the weekly spread tail; a single ~1.5-2.0p reopen print pushes deploy RT to ~2.2-2.7p and the +3.24 deploy row to ~+0.5-1.0p. Deploy-plane numbers are estimates, not stress bounds.
